Bravura 1.482
=============

Upstream: https://github.com/steinbergmedia/bravura
Tag: bravura-1.482
Commit: 37b194378b710cc40e406ab6c4b07608bb9548ae

The following upstream files are kept unmodified:

  redist/otf/Bravura.otf -> Bravura.otf
  redist/Bravura.json -> bravura_metadata.json
  LICENSE.txt -> LICENSE.txt

SHA256SUMS records their original byte digests.
We check them with cargo xtask check-music-font and when gd-engrave builds.
The SIL Open Font License 1.1 and the reserved font name remain with these files.

The Rust glyph-name table records standard code points from SMuFL metadata:
https://github.com/w3c/smufl/blob/60d1350f688431258302035d1ec46121d4dce958/metadata/glyphnames.json
Optional glyph code points come from the unmodified Bravura metadata.
The table records names and numeric assignments, not outlines or converted font data.
